about_the_game:
Wasteland Shop Simulator Demo is a quirky post-apocalyptic shop management game where you turn a rundown shack into a thriving retail empire. Stock shelves with scavenged goods, hire staff, fend off thieves, and keep eccentric customers happy while surviving in a dusty, dangerous world. Expand to new locations, customize your shop, and build your reputation in a wasteland where supply and demand take on a whole new meaning.

  • Shop Setup – Buy shelves, tables, corner racks, and more to design the ultimate scavenger’s storefront.

  • Decorate Your Store – Customize your space to reflect your unique post-apocalyptic aesthetic.

  • Rent Multiple Shops – Expand your retail empire across the wasteland.

  • Customize Signage – Change your store name and sign color to stand out from the competition.

  • Customer Chaos – Watch customers randomly mess up your displays — cleaning up is part of the job.

  • Hire Staff – Bring on workers to help with stocking, sales, and managing the madness.

  • Explore the Wasteland – Venture out to scavenge unique, valuable, or just plain weird items.

  • Beware of Thieves – Not everyone is there to buy — keep an eye on your goods!

Build your fortune from the ashes and prove that even after the world ends… retail never dies.
